evidence.text: EUCLYD is building AI infrastructure that aims to solve the compute and memory hurdle.

Euclyd — AI Infrastructure for Abundant Intelligence AI Infrastructure for Abundant Intelligence. Building a future in which advanced AI isn’t constrained by infrastructure cost, power availability, or geography. At the center of Euclyd's roadmap are craftwerk , the world's first agentic AI silicon, and CWS 32 , the world's lowest-power exascale AI factory. The platform combines programmable ASIC compute, processor-memory co-design, and system-level optimization to overcome the memory and efficiency walls limiting AI performance and scalability.
